item.text: [{"task_id":"84db8fc4","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    exterior = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    interior = int(round(params['colors'][2]))","    lower = int(round(params['bounds'][0]))","    inset = int(round(params['bounds'][1]))","    directions = []","    for pair in params['directions']:","        directions.append((int(round(pair[0])), int(round(pair[1]))))","    height, width = grid.shape","    result = grid.copy()","    visited = set()","    for row in range(height):","        for col in range(width):","            if grid[row, col] != background or (row, col) in visited:","                continue","            component = [(row, col)]","            visited.add((row, col))","            touches_border = False","            position = 0","            while position < len(component):","                r, c = component[position]","                position += 1","                if r == lower or c == lower or r == height - inset or c == width - inset:","                    touches_border = True","                for dr, dc in directions:","                    nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc","                    if lower <= nr < height and lower <= nc < width:","                        if grid[nr, nc] == background and (nr, nc) not in visited:","                            visited.add((nr, nc))","                            component.append((nr, nc))","            color = exterior if touches_border else interior","            for r, c in component:","                result[r, c] = color","    return result"],"shapes":{"colors":[3],"bounds":[2],"directions":[4,2]},"params":{"colors":[0,2,5],"bounds":[0,1],"directions":[[-1,0],[1,0],[0,-1],[0,1]]},"rationale":"Recolor each orthogonally connected zero component red (2) if it touches the grid boundary, otherwise gray (5). Preserve all other cells. The tensors encode the colors, boundary coordinates, and connectivity."}]
